What goes underground makes the estate above. 📐

Before you ever see the luxury finishes, there’s an incredible amount of work hidden beneath the surface. Due to groundwater on this coastal golf course lot, our engineering team required 74 steel-reinforced caissons to be drilled deep into bedrock to anchor the entire property.

When you're investing in high-end real estate, knowing the "bones" and engineering history of a property is everything.

Excited to be part of this week’s Metro Caravan and showcase this incredible residence overlooking beautiful Balboa Park! 🌳🏙️
Located in an exclusive 5-unit building, this one-of-a-kind home offers direct elevator access into your private residence, custom Borrelli cabinetry, hardwood floors, a fireplace, motorized shades, and Cantina-style doors that open to a spacious covered patio. Floor-to-ceiling windows capture breathtaking views of Balboa Park, the Bay, and Point Loma, creating the perfect blend of luxury and city living. ✨
With dual primary suites, no shared walls on the living level, two side-by-side secure parking spaces with storage, and walkability to museums, restaurants, shops, and the park, this is truly a rare opportunity in one of San Diego’s most desirable locations. 🔑
We can’t wait to share this exceptional property with our fellow agents and buyers!
